also: he brags too much about his money

terms.grammar: verb, first conjugation, with the thing boasted of in the accusative; sē jactāre, to brag
evidence: Caes. BC 3.83: jactāre urbānam grātiam et dignitātem (Lewis & Short)
Cic. de Or. 2.209: intolerantius sē jactāre (Lewis & Short)

phrases.english: He brags too much about his money.

sources: Lewis & Short: jacto
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 94, checked against the searchable text and the page images of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
